Posted April 30, 2001
(MarijuanaNews note: " Medical marijuana " is supported by over 70% of the American people; that is, they oppose arresting sick and dying people who use it with their doctors’ approval.
See
Gallup Poll Shows 73% Favor Medical Marijuana;
29% Favor Outright " Legalization "!
So What Are The Politicians Really Afraid Of?
and
The Party Line Versus Reality On Medical Marijuana.
Prohibitionism Is Being Destroyed By Its Own Delusions.
Analysis By Richard Cowan and 1 Article

This first item is the pure party line. The motivation of the author is very clear. He is a propagandist for the DEA and is just doing his job, just " following orders " as they used to say at Nuremberg.

The second is the party line with baroque embellishments.)


Note: Rich Isaacson is the Demand Reduction Coordinator, U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration, Detroit Division Office

THE MARIJUANA SMOKE SCREEN DEA

Your April 16 editorial " Marijuana: Leave room for relief for patients " ignored the real issues behind the effort to legalize marijuana for so-called medical purposes.

In 1999, the Institute of Medicine, having reviewed all the scientific evidence concerning the medical use of marijuana, concluded that there is little future in smoked marijuana as a medicine.
See
NORML Special Bulletin -- IOM Acknowledges:
" There is no clear alternative for people suffering from chronic conditions
that might be relieved by smoking marijuana, such as pain or AIDS wasting. "
and
Executive Summary Of The IOM Report, Marijuana And Medicine: Assessing The Science Base

State-by-state referendum campaigns, staged by drug advocates and bankrolled by billionaires, are no substitute for serious medical research.

Of course, nothing about this campaign represents a serious effort to alleviate pain and suffering. In fact, the campaign is simply a tactical maneuver in an overall strategy to legalize all drugs.

Copyright: 2001 Detroit Free Press

NEWS RELEASE

Representative Bob Barr
Contact:Brian Walsh (202) 225-2931
Georgia, 7th District
(MarijuanaNews note: Unlike most other prohibitionist Bob Barr has occasionally opposed some of the worst drug war excesses. He supported forfeiture reform and opposed the Hatch/Feinstein bill that would have tried to censor the Internet.

Nonetheless, he seems obsessed with medical marijuana. What puzzles me about this piece is why he thought it necessary. He hardly needs to establish his credentials as a drug warrior, and this is perhaps the worst way to do so. Who is the intended audience? Who do they think will be fooled by this particularly illogical rant?)

America's Children Sacrificed by Drug Legalizers

WASHINGTON, Apr. 16— Recently, the Supreme Court heard the case of U.S. v. Oakland Cannabis Buyers’ Cooperative; the issue of so-called " medical marijuana. " Although a ruling by the Court is not expected for several months, its significance for our future, for our children, cannot be overstated.
See
The Orange County Register Editorial Page Does the Best Job of Explaining the Significance of the Supreme Court’s Ruling on the Oakland Case.

Directly defying our efforts as a Congress and a nation, a small group of well-funded activists have engaged in deceptive, back-door, efforts to legalize drugs that are already banned under federal law.
(MarijuanaNews note: The " nation " and not the people? The October 11, 1999 issue National Review editorial comments on Barr’s blocking the DC Initiative 59 results,
" In November 1998, Bob Barr won reelection with 55 percent of the vote, which means that he has significantly less support than medical marijuana. "

Proponents hide behind the myth of the so-called ``medical'' use of marijuana, despite the fact that there is no scientific proof this mind-altering substance provides any real medical relief.
See
People With AIDS Benefit From – Not Harmed by Medical Marijuana in Government Approved Test. Politically Very Important – Medically Pointless.
and
80% of UK Doctors " would prescribe cannabis… if they were allowed to. "
and
Chairman of the House of Lords Science and Technology Committee
Criticizes UK Government’s Rejection Of Report On Medical Marijuana
– 2 Articles With 2 of the Worst Prohibitionist Arguments

From a purely political standpoint, the medicinal strategy has worked rather well for the legalizers. Backed by a handful of wealthy patrons like George Soros,
(MarijuanaNews note: Oddly, the one medical marijuana initiative that Barr blocked was in Washington, DC and was not backed by Soros or any of the other " billionaires " the prohibitionists love to hate. It was largely a local effort by the DC Chapter of Act-Up that fought Soros’s people.
See
Dueling Medical Marijuana Initiative Drives Planned for Washington, DC

Barr first blocked counting the votes and blocked implementing the initiative.)
See
Barr Trying Again to Silence DC’s Medical Marijuana Vote—
Bill Coming to House Floor Tomorrow – DRCNet Alert
in a few short years legalization advocates have transformed themselves from socially unacceptable pariahs into the darlings of the national media.
(MarijuanaNews note: Actually, we owe a lot to prohibitionists like Barr, who would make almost anyone seem reasonable by comparison.)
See
Editorial Page Editor of the Atlanta Constitution. Says " Barr is the Democrat’s best ally. "
and
Medical Marijuana Patients Protest At Barr’s Office.
Patient’s Husband Arrested.
Barr Says, " it is truly sad to see marijuana legalization activists using seriously ill patients
as props in their campaigns to make dangerous, mind-altering drugs legally available. "
– Also National Review Magazine Editorial Slams Barr

Increasingly, however, they have abandoned even this pretense, and made clear that their goal is the legalization or decriminalization of narcotic drugs. One activist called it the ``leaky bucket strategy ..... legalize it in one area, and sooner or later it will trickle down into the others.'' The bucket is now leaking faster than ever.
See
Is medical marijuana just the opening wedge to legalize marijuana generally?
and

A lackadasical attitude towards America’s drug war cannot be tolerated because our children will be the real victims.
See
Shalala Says That Parents Are Wrong To Be Relieved
That Their Children Are Using Marijuana Instead Of Heroin!
Survey Results From California Do Not Support Party Line, So They Are Buried.

According to a study published in the Journal of the American Medical Association last year, non-drug users who lived in households where drugs, including marijuana, are used are 11 times as likely to be killed as those living in drug-free households. So if a young person or an individual comes from a house where drugs are being used, this study by the American Medical Association said they increase their chances of being killed by 11 times.
(MarijuanaNews note: Obviously, this is a bit of a stretch. I could not find the referenced JAMA article, but notice that it included all " drugs " – not just marijuana. Has Barr decided that alcohol should be banned also? The National Clearinghouse for Alcohol and Drug Information report on " Domestic Violence & Alcohol and Other Drugs " said, " Alcohol is present in more than 50 percent of all incidents of domestic violence. " And -- " A 1993 study of more than 2,000 American couples found rates of domestic violence were almost 15 times higher in households where husbands were described as often drunk as opposed to never drunk. "

Of course, most people who drink do not kill their children.)

Marijuana was, and still is, a gateway drug; a dangerous mind altering substance that leads to abuse of other drugs like heroin, LSD, cocaine, and most recently, Ecstasy, and similar so-called " designer drugs. "
See
 " Those who insist on keeping the plant illegal bear a serious degree of moral responsibility for young marijuana users who do go on to use cocaine, heroin, PCP or other genuinely dangerous or addictive drugs. "
Alan Bock, of the Orange County Register On the Real Gateway

(MarijuanaNews note: The relevance of the rest of this depends on establishing not only that marijuana is a " gateway " drug and that having available medically would somehow lead children to use it and then other drugs.

I am sure that Barr would not ban medical morphine, so clearly he is in favor of children using it and barbiturates and cocaine, etc…)
